author: The Q
description:
My pool was a complete disaster after winter, so I decided to test the WYBOT S3 and see if it could actually handle real-world cleaning instead of just small demo situations.

With AI Vision, 3D mapping, wall climbing, automatic debris transfer, and solar charging, this feels much closer to a fully autonomous pool cleaning system than a normal pool robot.

EU Official Store: https://bit.ly/4v4Mq0l
US Official Store: https://bit.ly/4eXWzad

If you like this video - don't forget to subscribe :)
Production Music courtesy of Epidemic Sound www.epidemicsound.com

#wybots3 #wybot #poolcleaner
title: I Hate Cleaning Pools, So I Tried This Robot WYBOT S3
